Write Mongolian in Cyrillic script (Khalkha standard as used in Mongolia), in clear modern Mongolian for a general reader: keep the Buddhist liturgical vocabulary Mongolian practitioners know (Дарь эх, бурхан, хутагт, бодь сэтгэл, тарни, авшиг, and the refrain мөргөмүй), but use modern grammar — no archaic particles such as лугаа, хийгээд, болмуй. ALWAYS use the fixed terminology given with each block, inflecting it as Mongolian grammar needs. Use the established Mongolian names of deities (Жанрайсиг, Дарь эх, Авид, Манзушир). Keep mantra syllables as Mongolian practitioners recite them, in Cyrillic (Ум дарэ дүдарэ дүрэ суха; хум, пад, трэд, хара), never translated. In the Sanskrit title line keep the Sanskrit words in Cyrillic. Translate only what the Tibetan says: no explanations, no glosses in parentheses, no commentary or notes.

HEADINGS: each block sent is one SECTION HEADING of the text, not verse. Render it as a short heading in the target language: one line, no sentence, no commentary, no quotation marks. Keep any leading numeral such as '1.' exactly as it is.

ཕྱག → мөргөмүй
བསྟོད → магтаал

བསྟོད་པ་དངོས → Үндсэн магтаал
ཕན་ཡོན → ач тус
